description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing the backend API for a telemetry and predictive maintenance system. It defines endpoints for health checks, asset listing, telemetry ingestion and retrieval, prediction, model diagnostics, alert management, and alert acknowledgment. The code includes middleware for logging and request ID propagation, exception handlers for various error types, and initialization routines for storage and logging.

classes.name: AlertAckRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for acknowledging alerts, containing list of alert IDs and optional acknowledgment info.

classes.name: AlertAckResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for alert acknowledgment operation, indicating updated alerts and not found alerts.

classes.name: AlertFilter
classes.description: Filter criteria for listing alerts including asset ID, severity, acknowledgment status, time window, sorting, and pagination.

classes.name: AlertListResponse
classes.description: Response DTO containing a list of alerts and total count.

classes.name: APIError
classes.description: Standard error information with code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: AssetListItem
classes.description: Representation of an asset with ID, name, type, and status.

classes.name: ModelMetadata
classes.description: Information about the current prediction model's metadata: name, version, strategy, thresholds, updated timestamp.

classes.name: PredictionRequest
classes.description: Request DTO for prediction, including optional readings and asset ID, timestamp.

classes.name: PredictionResult
classes.description: Prediction outcome including risk score, severity, recommendation, and optional used timestamp.

classes.name: TelemetryAgg
classes.description: Enumeration for telemetry aggregation types: none, min, max, avg, p50, p90.

classes.name: TelemetryIngestResponse
classes.description: Response DTO for telemetry ingestion, containing count and list of inserted record IDs.

classes.name: TelemetryQueryResponse
classes.description: Return DTO for telemetry data retrieved, including asset ID, time window, aggregation, interval, and data points.

methods.name: None _configure_logging()
methods.description: Sets up basic logging configuration if none exists.

methods.name: list[str] _parse_cors_origins(raw: str | None)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of CORS origins into a list of strings.

methods.name: None _init_storage(app: FastAPI)
methods.description: Initializes embedded storage, seeds sample assets, and attaches storage instance to app state.

methods.name: str _get_or_create_request_id(request: Request)
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a unique request ID for tracing.

methods.name: ErrorResponse _error_response( *, code: str, message: str, status_code: int, request_id: str | None, details: Any | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructs a standardized error response DTO.
